children: naming DoorDash the official on-demand delivery and pick up partner of the NHL in Canada and the United States.
The exclusive deal begins immediately and marks DoorDash's first partnership with the NHL.
Under the agreement, DoorDash gains a broad set of marketing rights and NHL designations.
The season kicks off in Canada with a dedicated DoorDash Puck Drop promotion on September 29, 2026, followed by game night deals every Wednesday and Saturday for the regular season.
To reach even more households, DoorDash becomes the presenting sponsor of all Wednesday night regular-season national NHL games and Stanley Cup Playoff games broadcast on Prime Video in Canada.

title: DoorDash and NHL announce multiyear partnership across Canada, US
